Ever wonder why you're chasing The Notebook, A Walk to Remember, or Dear John vibes—and feeling like your own marriage is falling short? Or what about Purple Heart—that electric pull masked as perfect love?

Hollywood and books like Nicolas Sparks' The Choice teach us that true love means cheating if you’re not with your soulmate or relying on passion—and gloss over real emotional maturity. But it's all fantasy. In this episode, we go deep, comparing those glossy lies to what genuine, godly marriages look like—based on the Bible, built on stability, emotional growth, and yes, the timeless truths of the four temperaments. Even those temperaments can be found throughout the Scriptures.

We’ll also break down how your temperament influences the way you consume (and swallow) these Hollywood love stories. Are you the fiery choleric who buys into the drama? Or the pensive melancholic craving emotional depth? This episode is for you.
